summary: Initializes the driver index lookup table. Calls GlobalSignCheck (0x0046CB00) and returns 0 immediately if it fails. Otherwise iterates i from 0 to 103, reading each live driver identifier from dword_7CD470 (0x007CD470); when the identifier is non-negative the driver table entry dword_5F0730 at index 4656*v1 is written with the loop counter i. Returns 1 on success.

local_names.i: loop counter over the driver array (0..103)
local_names.v1: driver identifier read from dword_7CD470[i]; used as the table index when non-negative

operations.description: When GlobalSignCheck returns false the function returns 0 immediately
GlobalSignCheck is invoked as a precondition; its boolean result gates all table initialization
Iterate i over the range 0..103, reading a driver identifier from dword_7CD470 each pass
v1 = dword_7CD470[i]: read the current driver identifier from the input array
A negative driver identifier breaks the loop before any table write
Write the loop counter i into the driver table dword_5F0730 at entry 4656*v1 (stride 4656 per driver)

unresolved: The semantic role of GlobalSignCheck's gate and the meaning of the 4656-byte driver-table stride are not evidenced beyond the raw source; the stride itself is taken from the packet verbatim
